image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a silver alloy car wheel. The wheel features five Y-shaped spokes radiating from a central hub. The center cap is yellow with black text reading 'SUNRAYS' and '15x6J'. Five lug nuts are visible in the bolt holes. A portion of the black rubber tire is visible at the top edge. The background shows dark recesses of the wheel well.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the yellow center cap ('SUNRAYS') appears slightly distorted and irregular. The characters are not perfectly formed, showing slight melting/warping typical of AI generation, though legible enough to identify.

The lug nuts lack precise geometric definition. They appear somewhat 'mushy' or fused with the surrounding bolt holes rather than having sharp, machined edges. The reflections on them are inconsistent.
Minor softness/blurring where the spokes meet the outer rim and the center hub. The transitions are not perfectly sharp, suggesting slight generative smoothing.
